title: Allianz Global Investors — European Private Wealth Feeder Security & Scoping RFP
fund: Allianz European private wealth feeder platform
initialRequestBrief: Allianz Global Investors (€450k ARR) sent a 160-question security & scoping RFP for a European Private Wealth feeder platform (1,800 HNW investors managed by wealth advisors). Requires EU DORA compliance, Frankfurt data residency, and Swiss FINMA client confidentiality addendums.

contextTags.Regulation: EU DORA / GDPR / Swiss Banking Secrecy

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: A 185-question EU DORA and AI sub-processor questionnaire stalled procurement for six weeks until two real residency gaps were fixed and a verified master response bank and Frankfurt architecture brief were published.
pitfallWarnings: Re-verify every master answer before reuse; the bank's last_verified dates are October 2025.
Remote access from outside the EEA is a transfer; disclose and control it rather than deny it.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Master response bank with DORA/GDPR references, evidence, owners and last-verified dates.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Allianz security tab: DORA register of information, incident timelines, exit, AI sub-processors.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Reuse the master answers, re-verifying each one against the current architecture before submission.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Architecture brief: eu-central-1 component locations, regional keys, EU-only zero-retention AI inference.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: AGI-SEC-022 and AGI-SEC-048: every storage and processing location including AI inference.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Send the brief after SRE re-exports the egress allow-list and confirms inference routing.

deltaItems.category: Swiss FINMA banking secrecy waiver addendum
deltaItems.pastApproach: No precedent in the Memory Bank.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: AGI-CH-131/132: client confidentiality addendum and banking secrecy waiver for Swiss-booked investors.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Legal to draft with Allianz's Swiss counsel; scope which entities see client-identifying data and under whose consent.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: Scoping on the institutional template underestimated delivery by four weeks because advisors needed 1-to-many delegated preparation; a phased delivery saved the first close and produced a scoping rubric and access matrix.
pitfallWarnings: Ask who fills in the forms, not just how many investors there are, before quoting.
End-date advisor access when a relationship manager changes firm.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Access matrix for about 60 US RIA advisors (2,500 investors), scoped by active rep code.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: About 40 European wealth managers preparing subscriptions for 1,800 HNW investors.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Start from the matrix but replace US rep codes with the wealth manager's firm and mandate (advisory or discretionary), and re-check who may attest.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Rubric multiplier on the institutional baseline; Brookfield quoted 6 weeks, delivered 10.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Run the rubric on Allianz's inputs before committing to a timeline in the RFP.
